text:
kevin: Heads-up — I'm seeing a regression in nightly CI for kernel selection on Llama-2-13B-qlora. Throughput down ~12% vs baseline. cc @maria @samir

maria: which job? the nightly 'replay-bench' or synthetic 'loadgen'?

kevin: replay-bench (1743650000-run) — attached logs: latency p50 up from 95ms -> 110ms on A100-80GB.

samir: can you paste the perf summary? also did KV-cache hit rate change?

kevin: paste:
```text
Model LLM-13B-qlora | kernel selected: matmul_v2 -> matmul_v1
Batching strategy: dynamic_batcher(32) -> dynamic_batcher(16)
KV cache hit: 0.87 -> 0.86
p50 latency: 95ms -> 110ms
tokens/s: 5100 -> 4500
```

sylvie: hmm matmul change suggests kernel selector picked different kernel due to sequence length histogram shift. Did input seq distribution change in replay harness?

maria: replay harness got updated two commits ago — we added some longer chat contexts to better match prod. Might have shifted median seq to 256 from 128.

samir: OK that explains kernel choice. We need apples-to-apples: add an option in replay harness to preserve original sequence histogram for baseline runs. Also add tagging so nightly compares identical input distributions.

kevin: agree. Filed a tiny PR: https://git.redwood/infra/replay-harness/pull/412 — adds --seeded-histogram and metadata publishing to bench artifacts. cc @sylvie :eyes: 

sylvie: nice. Also suggest CI automation that runs both 'prod-like' and 'baseline' distributions in parallel and treats diffs separately. Alerting should be per-distribution.

maria: regarding flaky test triage — we should suppress alerts for known noisy kernels for 24h and add "regression-investigation" label to dashboard. Current threshold is 5% p50 change; maybe widen for high-variance workloads.

ops-bot: nightly-bench started run 1743651200 — artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/1743651200/ :gear:

kevin: extracted flamegraphs and KV profiles:
```text
hotspots:
- aten::matmul_kernel_v1 42%
- attention_kv_update 18%
- cublas_sgemm 12%
```

diane: can we add kernel-level flags to force kernel choice in runtime for A/B runs? I can add a runtime config toggle for CI only.

sylvie: that's perfect. Add a test matrix: (default-auto, force_v1, force_v2) x (baseline-hist, prod-hist). Then publish delta table to dashboards and annotate PRs.

maria: I'll update the nightly pipeline YAML: add matrix and set alerting rules. Also hooking flaky triage: when a new regression appears, open an internal issue with logs + perf artifact link.

samir: one more — add KV-cache microbenchmark to CI that runs synthetic hits/misses and validates cache eviction behavior after recent mempool changes.

kevin: thanks all. I'll merge the replay PR after CI passes. Will follow up with a small postmortem if regression persists. :thumbsup:
